Level 1 - Kid 35 min LLD OOP C to Java / C++

From C Structs to Objects: OOP for Kernel Engineers

You have been writing objects for years: every struct with a pointer to a const struct ..._ops table is one. This page maps that kernel habit onto classes, interfaces, inheritance and polymorphism in Java and C++, shows the same program in all three languages, and lists what the languages give you that C makes you do by hand.
